{{Quote|A gas freighter on the way to Ryoone had to drop out of hyperspace to make repairs.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Ryoone''' was a dismal [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] characterized by a "seemingly permanent suspension of ash in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]." It was inhabited by six [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, including the [[Lyunesi]].
